title: A House for the Portrait
author: Mara Hartwell
blurb: Jude Pemberton, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
